profile.headline: Senior Engineer at AllTrails
profile.geoLocationName: Palos Verdes Peninsula, California, United States
profile.summary:
Lead Software Engineer focusing on the development and implementation of mobile technologies with 8+ years of experience.
Specialized in fast moving ecosystems that require constant adaptability of engineering requirements and feature sets. Managed multiple releases of multiple customer facing applications. Experienced working with SaaS business paradigms and taking decisions on technological solutions to best fit business and user requirements.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented the architecture and frameworks that are used as the backbone of the company’s applications across multiple platforms
Hired, supervised, and mentored a team of engineers that developed and maintained both iOS and Android projects
Developed multiple native iOS mobile applications that allowed registration, discovery and management of competitive events
Spearheaded the development of multiple mobile technologies including payment processing, geo-fencing, live scoring and more 
Worked with project owners and managers to determine optimal technology solutions and development timeframes that captured the company’s vision and needs
Facilitated communication across engineers, designers, product owners, project managers, and quality assurance
Managed the release process of the company’s flagship apps
Worked with project managers to implement agile methodologies and fine tune the development process of the company
Lead the migration of company apps from cross-platform to native

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained native and cross-platform applications that allowed users to find and register for a multitude of events
Implemented Object Oriented application design and development patterns. 
Designed the UI/UX for the company’s apps 
Developed complex algorithms used in the management of record setting tournaments

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
Fined tuned cross-platforms applications to ensure proper performance across multiple devices 
Worked with a small group of interns to develop a scoring application for a popular board game
